Definition: to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to break through or down or over, burst, breach; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to break or burst out (from womb or enclosure); 1a2) to break through or down, make a breach in; 1a3) to break into; 1a4) to break open; 1a5) to break up, break in pieces; 1a6) to break out (violently) upon; 1a7) to break over (limits), increase; 1a8) to use violence; 1a9) to burst open 1a10) to spread, distribute; 1b) (Niphal) to be broken through; 1c) (Pual) to be broken down; 1d) (Hithpael) to break away
